next.reason: 1985: status 10 when 'no next logical record exists in the file because: 1) The end of the file has been reached, or 2) A sequential READ statement is attempted for the first time on an optional input file that is not present.' §2023:9.1.13.4 GR1 keeps both (a, c) and adds 'b) PREVIOUS was specified and the beginning of the physical file has been reached' ('no next or prior logical record'); READ sets '10' and fails (§2023:14.9.30.4 GR21, GR24). A program 2023 accepts (READ PREVIOUS) reaches status 10 by a cause the 1985 list does not have: a case added.
